items: 瞒天过海
mán tiān guò hǎi
Deceive the heavens to cross the sea
Hide your real aim behind routine, openly seen moves, then act while the other side is off guard.
用伪装和惯常的举动掩盖真实意图，乘人不备而行动。
围魏救赵
wéi wèi jiù zhào
Besiege Wei to rescue Zhao
Instead of meeting a strong force head on, strike what it must protect so it turns back.
不直接救援，而是攻击敌人后方要害，迫使其回兵自救。
借刀杀人
jiè dāo shā rén
Kill with a borrowed knife
Let a third party, or the enemy's own strength, do the damage for you.
自己不出面，借用他人的力量打击对手。
以逸待劳
yǐ yì dài láo
Wait at leisure while the enemy labors
Rest and prepare while the enemy wears itself out, then strike.
养精蓄锐，等敌人疲惫时再出击。
趁火打劫
chèn huǒ dǎ jié
Loot a burning house
Take advantage when an opponent is caught in a crisis.
趁对方陷入危难之时，出手攫取利益。
声东击西
shēng dōng jī xī
Make a sound in the east, then strike in the west
Feint in one direction to draw the defense, then attack where it is weak.
佯装攻打东面，实际攻打西面，使敌人判断失误。
无中生有
wú zhōng shēng yǒu
Create something from nothing
Make an illusion believable so the other side acts on something unreal.
以假乱真，使对方把虚假当作真实。
明修栈道暗渡陈仓
míng xiū zhàn dào, àn dù chén cāng
Openly repair the gallery roads, but sneak through the passage of Chencang
Draw attention with an open, slow plan while you move by a hidden route.
表面上做一件事吸引注意，暗中另走一条路达到目的。
隔岸观火
gé àn guān huǒ
Watch the fires burning across the river
Stay out while rivals fight among themselves, then move once they are weakened.
对方内乱时静观其变，待其自相削弱再行动。
笑里藏刀
xiào lǐ cáng dāo
Hide a knife behind a smile
Win trust with friendliness while planning harm in secret.
表面和善友好，暗中阴险加害。
李代桃僵
lǐ dài táo jiāng
Sacrifice the plum tree to preserve the peach tree
Give up something minor to save what matters most.
舍弃局部或次要的东西，以保全整体或主要的东西。
顺手牵羊
shùn shǒu qiān yáng
Take the opportunity to pilfer a goat
Pick up any small advantage that comes along on the way.
趁机顺便获取利益，不放过小的机会。
打草惊蛇
dǎ cǎo jīng shé
Stomp the grass to scare the snake
Probe so a hidden opponent reveals itself; also, a careless move that alerts them.
试探对方以探明虚实；也指行动不慎，惊动了对方。
借尸还魂
jiè shī huán hún
Borrow a corpse to resurrect the soul
Revive something discarded or forgotten and put it to new use.
利用已经没落或无用的事物，使之为己所用，重新兴起。
调虎离山
diào hǔ lí shān
Lure the tiger down the mountain
Draw an opponent away from the ground that gives it strength.
设法使对手离开有利的阵地，再趁机行事。
欲擒故纵
yù qín gù zòng
In order to capture, one must let loose
Ease the pressure on a cornered enemy so its will to fight fades, then take it.
想要捉住对方，先故意放松，使其放松警惕。
抛砖引玉
pāo zhuān yǐn yù
Toss out a brick to attract a jade gem
Offer something small to draw out something of greater value.
先拿出价值较小的东西，引出更有价值的回报。
擒贼擒王
qín zéi qín wáng
Defeat the enemy by capturing their chief
Take the leader and the rest falls apart.
打击敌人首领，使其整体瓦解。
釜底抽薪
fǔ dǐ chōu xīn
Remove the firewood from under the pot
Cut off the source of the opponent's strength instead of fighting its force.
从根本上解决问题，削弱对方力量的来源。
混水摸鱼
hùn shuǐ mō yú
Disturb the water and catch a fish
Stir up confusion and profit from it.
趁局面混乱之时，从中谋取利益。
金蝉脱壳
jīn chán tuō qiào
Slough off the cicada's golden shell
Leave an outward shell behind to cover a quiet escape.
留下外表假象迷惑对方，本体暗中脱身。
关门捉贼
guān mén zhuō zéi
Shut the door to catch the thief
Close every way out before you strike.
切断退路，把敌人围困后歼灭。
远交近攻
yuǎn jiāo jìn gōng
Befriend a distant state and strike a neighbouring one
Make friends far away and attack those close by.
结交远方的国家，攻打邻近的国家。
假途伐虢
jiǎ tú fá guó
Obtain safe passage to conquer the State of Guo
Borrow passage against one enemy, then turn on the one who lent it.
以借道为名，行吞并之实。
偷梁换柱
tōu liáng huàn zhù
Replace the beams with rotten timbers
Quietly swap out the key supports and substitute your own.
暗中更换事物的关键部分，以假代真。
指桑骂槐
zhǐ sāng mà huái
Point at the mulberry tree while cursing the locust tree
Criticize one target to warn another indirectly.
指着这个骂那个，比喻借题发挥，间接警告或批评。
假痴不癫
jiǎ chī bù diān
Feign madness but keep your balance
Act the fool while keeping a clear head.
假装糊涂，暗中却保持清醒，伺机而动。
上屋抽梯
shàng wū chōu tī
Remove the ladder when the enemy has ascended to the roof
Lure the opponent onto the roof, then take the ladder away.
引诱对方上去后撤掉梯子，断其退路。
树上开花
shù shàng kāi huā
Decorate the tree with false blossoms
Dress up a weak position so it looks strong.
借助外物虚张声势，使力量显得强大。
反客为主
fǎn kè wéi zhǔ
Make the host and the guest exchange roles
Start in a subordinate place and gradually take control.
由被动转为主动，从客位逐步取得主导地位。
美人计
měi rén jì
The beauty trap
Use beauty to distract a leader and weaken his judgment.
以美色迷惑对方，使其丧失斗志或判断。
空城计
kōng chéng jì
The empty fort strategy
When weak, show it openly and calmly so the enemy suspects a trap.
在力量空虚时故意示弱，使对方疑有埋伏而不敢进攻。
反间计
fǎn jiàn jì
Let the enemy's own spy sow discord in the enemy camp
Turn the enemy's spies and doubts against them so they turn on each other.
利用敌方间谍或制造嫌隙，使敌人内部互相猜疑。
苦肉计
kǔ ròu jì
Inflict injury on oneself to win the enemy's trust
Hurt yourself to win the enemy's trust, then act.
故意伤害自己以取得对方信任，再伺机行事。
连环计
lián huán jì
Chain stratagems
Link several stratagems so each one sets up the next.
多个计策环环相扣，连续使用。
走为上策
zǒu wéi shàng cè
If all else fails, retreat
When the odds are against you, withdraw and keep your strength for another day.
形势不利时，撤退是最好的选择，保存实力以图再起。
